title: STEP location proof claim (step.proof.location.v1)
description: Signed mining claim produced by the miner app. The app never claims final validity; it only produces evidence (DEV §6.4). Raw coordinates in this object exist ONLY in the encrypted off-chain evidence path — this object must never be written on-chain or to logs (PRV-001).

triangle_id.description: Deterministic triangle ID per step-mesh-v1 (ADR-002): STEP-{level}-F{face:02}[-{base4path}]

integrity_mode.description: ADR-015: 'attested' = real App Attest + DeviceCheck; 'dev-unattested' accepted only by validators with allow_dev_claims=true; never silently upgraded

app_attestation.description: Opaque Apple App Attest token (base64); required when integrity_mode=attested

device_integrity.description: Opaque DeviceCheck token (base64); required when integrity_mode=attested

payload.description: Signed rotating QR payload scanned at the POI

signature.description: EIP-712 secp256k1 signature by wallet_address over the claim struct (domain: StepMiningClaim v1)
